name: Tenison Park Golf Course – Glen
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (2871); its handicaps match OpenStreetMap's hole tags, its pars too except #13 (OSM: par 5; card: par 4, 410 yards), so the card's are used (par 72). Ratings matched to tees by total yards; men's, Red has only the women's rating.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: the two practice greens by the clubhouse (and the fairway round one) and a chipping green west of the Highlands' #1.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it.
